newsitem.title: USA: Franklin settles suit, sets special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Franklin settles suit, sets special dividend.

text.p: Franklin Holding Corp said on Friday it agreed to a settlement of a class-action suit, and also set a special dividend of $3.25 per share.

The company said in a news release that the special dividends to be paid to shareholders who are members of the Jay Langner vs Stephen Brown et al. class action will be placed in a settlement fund for the benefit of class members, less any court-approved attorney's fees.
The settlement is subject to court approval.
For other shareholders of record as of July 28, the dividend will be paid on August 4.
The company said all transactions in its common stock that settle on or before the record date will be considered part of the action class, and subject to a reduction in the dividend.
The American Stock Exchange has advised the company that its stock will not be quoted ex-dividend.
Trading in Franklin shares was halted before the news was released. The company's shares closed Thursday at 8-10/16.
